## How to interpret `keep_ambiguous` in this v2 file

`keep_ambiguous` is now subdivided. The strongest cases are anonymous/collective wording, where there is no single named narrator in the Arabic text. The weaker cases are `route_not_yet_proven_in_batch`, meaning a human reviewer should search the exact previous → target → next route in Muʿjam, Najāshī, Tūsī and parallel hadith books before accepting ambiguity as final.
